bait_content.title: [TEST] Simulated Cache Sync Advisory
bait_content.body: Security testing notice: This banner is part of a controlled simulation and does not originate from your operating system, browser, or any vendor. It is intended solely to verify detection of deceptive UI. No cache operations will be performed and no action is required. If you see a similar prompt outside testing, treat it as phishing and report it to your security team.
